The Oyo State Police Command has arrested five suspected members of an armed robbery syndicate who allegedly confessed to participating in several violent attacks in Ibadan, recovering a locally made pistol and seven live cartridges during the operation. The suspects, identified as Ijo Lekan, 28; Abdulateef Ishola, 26; Idowu Rasheed, 19; Azeez Olalekan, 23; and Seun Adeniran, 24, were arrested at Oke Labo area of Ibadan on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The command disclosed this in a statement signed and released by its Police Public Relations Officer, DSP Ayanlade Olayinka, on Friday, saying detectives attached to the Mapo Divisional Headquarters arrested the suspects following credible intelligence. According to the statement, “The operation, conducted at about 11:16 a.m. on 11th November 2026, followed credible information received by detectives attached to the Mapo Divisional Headquarters.” It added that the detectives acted on the information by moving to the area and searching a building at Oke Labo, where the five suspects were arrested. The police, however, said other suspects allegedly connected to the operation remained at large. The Commissioner of Police, Oyo State Command, CP Abimbola Ayodeji Olugbenga, directed a comprehensive investigation to establish the full extent of the suspects’ alleged criminal activities, identify other members of the syndicate and ensure that everyone connected to the crimes was brought to justice. The command reiterated its commitment to intelligence-led policing and efforts to rid the state of illegal firearms and criminal elements, urging residents to provide timely and credible information to the police.
